type.label: Type
type.description: Choose the type of project you want to create. The type will determine the structure and files that will be generated for your project.

folder_name.label: Folder name
folder_name.description: Enter the name of the folder where your project's information will be generated and written.
folder_name.placeholder: Enter the name of the project's folder.

overview_title.label: Overview title
overview_title.description: Enter the inline title of the project's overview file. This title will replace the {{ title }} placeholder in the project overview template. This is useful if you have invalid or special characters in the title that cannot be used in the file name.
overview_title.placeholder: Enter the title of the project's overview file.

delete.title: Delete an existing project
delete.warning: Deleting a project is not reversible. The project and all of its file will be deleted forever... Forever is quite long.

project.label: Project
project.description: Choose to which project the created epic belongs. The file will be created in the epic folder of the chosen project.
project.placeholder: Start typing the name of a project...

epic_file_name.label: File name
epic_file_name.description: Enter the name of the file that will be created for the epic.
epic_file_name.placeholder: Enter the name of the file.

epic_title.label: Title
epic_title.description: Enter the inline title of the epic. This title will replace the {{ title }} placeholder in the epic template. This is useful if you have invalid or special characters in the title that cannot be used in the file name.
epic_title.placeholder: Enter the title of the epic.

project.label: Project
project.description: Choose to which project the created user story belongs. The file will be created in the user story folder of the chosen project.
project.placeholder: Start typing the name of a project...

user_story_file_name.label: File name
user_story_file_name.description: Enter the name of the file that will be created for the user story.
user_story_file_name.placeholder: Enter the name of the file.

user_story_title.label: Title
user_story_title.description: Enter the inline title of the user story. This title will replace the {{ title }} placeholder in the user story template. This is useful if you have invalid or special characters in the title that cannot be used in the file name.
user_story_title.placeholder: Enter the title of the user story.

path.label: Project folder path

path.placeholder: Start to type the name of a folder...
